name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engineering and a deep-seated love for speed. Growing up in Belgrade, he spent hours tinkering with engines and building scale models of racing cars. After completing his degree in mechanical engineering, Nikola honed his skills at a local automotive workshop before securing a coveted position at a smaller racing outfit. There, he gained valuable experience in fabricating parts and contributing to vehicle performance.

His meticulous approach and dedication to precision quickly earned him recognition. Nikola is known for his ability to quickly adapt to new challenges and find creative solutions to complex fabrication problems. He prides himself on his attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality results, ensuring that every component he crafts meets the highest standards. Nikola brings a flexible and collaborative mindset to the team, always eager to learn and contribute to the overall success of the racing program.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Nikola is of average height with a muscular build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and measurements.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working on intricate parts.
Insists on cleaning his workspace thoroughly at the end of each day.
